## Implementation Notes
Modify plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/conflict_resolver.py:
- Add 'title': 'state' and 'type': 'state' to FIELD_CLASSES (lines 19-28). Preserve dict-of-strings shape — applier.py:585-589 depends on FIELD_CLASSES.get(...) == 'set'.
- Add ledger: ProvenanceLedger | None = None kwarg to resolve_field (line 106). When ledger is not None, after each resolution call ledger.record(element_class=field_name, element_id=<id>, side=<winning_side>, timestamp=<pass_ts>, content_hash=<sha256 of resolved value>).
- For scalars: one ledger.record per resolve_field call.
- For additive list / set strategies: one ledger.record per element with that element's content-hash.
- Backward-compat: existing call sites passing no ledger keep working (None default).
- DO NOT touch resolve_set_valued's existing provenance_record FIFO param (line 72) — that is independent set-level mechanism; this story adds per-element via the new ledger. Both populate independently; no double-tracking interaction.

Test file: create NEW file tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_provenance.py (T4 will create a SEPARATE file test_conflict_resolver_provenance_matrix.py — do NOT extend this file in T4).

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

1. The 5 existing files to gate are (paths verbatim):
   - tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver.py
   - tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_conflict_resolver_cap.py

2. Coexistence contract: ledger and provenance_record FIFO are INDEPENDENT records — neither derives from the other. resolve_set_valued continues to write to provenance_record (line 87-96, FIFO cap=50); when ledger is non-None it ALSO writes to ledger.
3. Suppression is the EXCLUSIVE responsibility of is_echo (called from the differ before mutation emission). The FIFO provenance_record list is a passive audit record — never used for suppression. Add explicit test asserting: a set element appearing in BOTH provenance_record and ledger.to_dict() does NOT cause double mutation emission from differ.compute_mutations.
